notes.title: The price has been reduced more than 3 times.
notes.content:
I lowered the base price from $7 to $2. I think it's fair, I spent a lot of time on it. I don't have any big plans for the game, but I hope to at least recoup the price for the slot.

I'll try to release a demo of my new game by the June games festival, but I'm not sure I'll make it. I'll take all my mistakes into account and focus on the demo version and player feedback.

I'll also try to release an update for Planeticus and release it within this year.

Unfortunately, I can't promise anything. I don’t have a lot of free time and I’m doing it all alone.

notes.title: The game will be free. It's long overdue.
notes.content: I have made my decision. The game will be completely free in about a week or so. I can't promise any major updates. I'm up to my neck in work and surviving as best I can.

notes.title: News about the future development of the game
notes.content:
Hi all.
I want to share it with those few people who care about the fate of the game.

The game has not paid for itself at all and is mostly filled with negative impressions. If it shows itself better during the New Year's sale, then I will continue development at a more vigorous pace and devote myself entirely to it. For now, the plan is to release an update every few months. Sooner or later I will bring it to release.

If the game resonates more with players, I'll definitely return to more active development, but not right now. I invested a gigantic amount of my energy, time and hopes. I won’t give up the project so easily, but the motivation to continue has diminished.

At the moment, in my free time from work, I am developing another game. Even though this is not a multiplayer game, it is a relaxing 3D game with an interesting plot and puzzles, and I will try to give it a unique and cool graphic component.

I really want to make games all my free time, but the financial component does not allow me to do this, the realities of life. I got myself into debt while developing this game and I really want to get rid of this burden. I am also very grateful to those who did buy the game and did not return it. I hope I can recover quickly financially and mentally.

Thank you for your attention!
